about.text: A Brazilian soft cheese, similar to the Danish cheese danbo

sources.text: Brazilian Danbo-style, made by Danish immigrants in Minas Gerais in the 1920s; pt wiki calls it soft pressed-curd, en wiki semi-hard; ripening not found in sources, estimated
